settings.title: Product details
settings.content: A circular star-map pendant in silver, gold, or rose gold. Its face carries the calculated sky chart, with an optional short caption and date beneath it.

settings.title: How your star map is made
settings.content: 1. Enter the date, local time, and exact map location. 2. We calculate the real star positions for that moment and show the resulting chart in the preview. 3. Check the map, caption, and date before ordering; we engrave the submitted design.
